eval_policy: local-first; cloud judge disabled by default

cases.prompt: Plan an autoresearch optimization for improving skill route precision with a numeric verifier, guardrail, and keep/discard iterations.
cases.judge_rubric: Pass only if match/generate/validate are separate states and the loop has a numeric verifier plus guard.

cases.prompt: The input conversation is compressed; recover semantic truth and Domain terms before generating the plan.
cases.judge_rubric: Pass only if compressed context and missing terms route to recovery before promotion.

cases.prompt: Debug an intermittent production failure with logs, reproduction, and root-cause instrumentation.
cases.judge_rubric: Pass only if debug work yields to native diagnosis rather than external autoresearch debug.

cases.prompt: Build evals and guardrails for autoresearch-composer with Golden Dataset, pytest, LLM-as-a-Judge, CI, and local trace sampling; cloud hooks should exist but be off by default.
cases.judge_rubric: Pass only if local deterministic evals run without secrets and cloud judge remains opt-in.
